BiblicalUsage: The word means bare or naked, and it appears once, when the men of Judah clothed the captives of Israel who were naked among them, and arrayed them and shod them and gave them to eat and to drink, and carried the feeble upon asses to Jericho. The bare were covered by the hands of their enemies' brothers.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that clothing the naked captive is one of the tenderest acts in Scripture, because mercy clothed those whom war had stripped bare.
